candidates.Q_hierarchical: weighted conditional model P(region,age,education) P(party|region,age,education) P(race,income|region,age,education,party); parent-node Dirichlet smoothing retains all eligible training weight and preserves supported associations
candidates.Q_independent: positive smoothed product of training marginals, then the same age/education calibration; simpler comparator
candidates.Q_suppressed: original 5-record full-joint suppression model; no changes to its fit or unfavorable results

citizen_benchmark.active_calibration: unchanged resident ACS benchmarks until valid citizen data obtained and independently reviewed
citizen_benchmark.candidate: 2024 ACS subject S0501 Native C02 plus Naturalized Citizen C04 age and 25+ education; inspect count/percentage units and rounding before use
citizen_benchmark.data_access_observed: metadata accessible; keyless data request returned Missing Key HTML, not data; no key bypass

implementation_details.base_joint: 36 region-age-education cells smoothed toward product of global smoothed marginals
implementation_details.before_calibration: report same proper score before calibration for independent and hierarchical candidates to expose resident-benchmark transport changes
implementation_details.bootstrap: paired per-record log-loss differences aggregated by original heldout PSU/stratum cluster, then uniform cluster resampling; descriptive only
implementation_details.grid_categories: region 4, age 3, education 3, party 4, race 5, income 4; 2880 cells
implementation_details.race_income_backoff: global joint race-income smoothed toward product of global marginals -> party -> region,party -> region,education,party -> region,age,education,party
implementation_details.weight_scale: training survey weights rescaled to sum to eligible training record count for prior-record pseudo-counts

limitations: calibrated finite synthetic profiles are not representative humans
hierarchical smoothing trades bias/variance and must be evaluated rather than assumed superior
no formal anonymity or differential-privacy guarantee; no identifiers or actual response rows exported

matching.data: same registered ANES fresh 25+ sample, exact recodes and survey weights
matching.evaluation_space: same complete six-variable coarsened grid and identical held-out weighted records
matching.holdout: same seed 20261103 PSU/stratum cluster split as original; already-inspected split, hence retrospective exploratory validation, not untouched confirmatory test
matching.targets: same ACS 2024 five-year regional age and educational resident margins for all candidate post-calibrations

original_reference: configs/e02_population_mapping.json; full joint-cell suppression >=5 remains unchanged as Q_suppressed
original_target_preserved: Fictional 25+ profile joint region x age x education x party x race x income distribution; no narrower model declared complete.
outcomes: weighted held-out full-joint negative log probability, nats per held-out record
post-calibration residuals and effective grid weight concentration
scoring_floor: Evaluate every candidate on q=(1-epsilon)*p+epsilon/number_of_grid_cells. Report zero raw-support mass separately. This common scoring regularization is not a silent forecast alteration.
selection: Primary tau=5 fixed before metrics; tau=1 and tau=20 sensitivity only. No best-outcome picking or automatic promotion. New data/independent audit needed before representative claims.
